how_to_use: Generate each image at (or above) the listed size, export as WebP (quality 90) and save it to the exact output path inside dignifyd-site/public. The site picks each file up automatically; until a file exists the slot shows its built-in fallback, so nothing breaks.

global_style.palette: pure black (#0a0a0a) background, off-white (#f5f5f5) forms, a single crimson accent (#ee1a43) used sparingly, no other hues
global_style.look: premium editorial tech, dark, high contrast, crisp micro-detail, subtle film grain, soft volumetric light, shallow depth of field
global_style.motifs: dot-matrix / particle point clouds, fine hairline geometry, glass and brushed metal, quiet negative space
hard_rules: no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image
sharp focus on the subject, no blur on the main form, no compression artefacts, no pixelation
subject fully inside the frame with generous margins; nothing important touching or cut by the edges
keep the right third calmer for the 16:9 tiles (UI may overlap the corners)
global_style.negative_prompt: text, typography, watermark, logo, signature, letters, numbers, faces, people, blurry, lowres, jpeg artifacts, pixelated, cropped subject, cut off, oversaturated, rainbow colours, neon blue, purple, green, cartoon, clipart, busy background
